import {
  EventStatus,
  OrderStatus,
  PaymentStatus,
  type Prisma,
} from "@prisma/client";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/db";
import { slugify } from "@/lib/utils";
import { writeAuditLog } from "@/lib/audit";
import { AppError } from "@/lib/api-error";
import { sendEventCancelledEmail } from "@/lib/email/templates";
import {
  getEventFinancialTotals,
  getOrgFinancialTotals,
} from "@/lib/admin/event-financials";
import { RefundService } from "@/services/refund-service";
import { ReservationService } from "@/services/reservation-service";

export class EventService {
  static async listPublic(params?: { take?: number; city?: string }) {
    const now = new Date();
    return prisma.event.findMany({
      where: {
        status: { in: [EventStatus.PUBLISHED, EventStatus.PAUSED, EventStatus.SOLD_OUT] },
        visibility: "PUBLIC",
        startsAt: { gte: now },
        ...(params?.city ? { city: { equals: params.city, mode: "insensitive" } } : {}),
      },
      include: {
        organization: { select: { name: true, slug: true } },
        venue: true,
        ticketTypes: {
          where: { isVisible: true },
          orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" },
          include: { priceTiers: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" } } },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { startsAt: "asc" },
      take: params?.take ?? 50,
    });
  }

  static async getBySlug(
    slug: string,
    opts?: { skipInventoryCleanup?: boolean }
  ) {
    const event = await prisma.event.findFirst({
      where: {
        slug,
        // HIDDEN events are admin-only (preview via /admin/events/[id], not public slug)
        visibility: { in: ["PUBLIC", "UNLISTED"] },
        OR: [
          { status: { in: [EventStatus.PUBLISHED, EventStatus.PAUSED, EventStatus.SOLD_OUT] } },
          { visibility: "UNLISTED", status: { not: EventStatus.DRAFT } },
        ],
      },
      include: {
        organization: true,
        sellerOrganization: true,
        venue: true,
        images: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" } },
        ticketTypes: {
          where: { isVisible: true },
          orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" },
          include: { priceTiers: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" } } },
        },
      },
    });
    if (!event) return null;

    // Metadata / OG tags do not need live counters — skip opportunistic cleanup.
    if (opts?.skipInventoryCleanup) {
      return event;
    }

    return EventService.withFreshInventory(event);
  }

  /**
   * Run opportunistic reservation cleanup for an already-loaded event and, only if
   * inventory actually changed, re-read its ticket types. Lets callers share one
   * event query between metadata and page render.
   */
  static async withFreshInventory<
    T extends { id: string; ticketTypes: unknown[] },
  >(event: T): Promise<T> {
    // Opportunistic: expire/rebuild only outside throttle + when SQL invariant
    // detects drift. Avoids a full repair dry-run on every public page view.
    let cleaned = false;
    try {
      const result = await ReservationService.cleanupEventSafe(event.id);
      cleaned = Boolean(
        result &&
          !result.dryRun &&
          result.applied &&
          (result.expiredCount > 0 || result.types.some((t) => t.delta !== 0))
      );
    } catch {
      // Prefer returning inventory over failing the page
    }

    if (!cleaned) return event;

    const ticketTypes = await prisma.ticketType.findMany({
      where: { eventId: event.id, isVisible: true },
      orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" },
      include: { priceTiers: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" } } },
    });
    return { ...event, ticketTypes } as T;
  }

  /**
   * Public URLs are `/events/{slug}` (looked up without an org), so slugs must be
   * unique across ALL organizations — otherwise two orgs' events collide and a
   * buyer can land on the wrong event. Appends -2, -3, … until free.
   */
  static async uniqueSlug(base: string): Promise<string> {
    const root = base || "arrangement";
    const take
